name: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: > Under the scheme, registered construction workers receive financial assistance of ₹12,000/- in two installments for the construction of toilets. - **First Installment:** ₹8,000/- - **Second Installment:** ₹4,000/-
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
